dz: 在邓弗里斯格雷修士教堂的高坛前，罗伯特·布鲁斯谋杀了约翰·科明，引发了苏格兰独立战争的革命。
de: In front of the high altar of Greyfriars Church in Dumfries, Robert the Bruce murders John Comyn, sparking the revolution in the Wars of Scottish Independence.

t: 布鲁斯人罗伯特成为苏格兰国王(苏格兰).
te: Robert the Bruce becomes King of Scots (Scotland).
dz: 布鲁斯人罗伯特成为苏格兰国王(苏格兰).
de: Robert the Bruce becomes King of Scots (Scotland).

t: 彭布罗克伯爵的军队在梅斯文战役中击败了布鲁斯的苏格兰军队.
te: The Earl of Pembroke's army defeats Bruce's Scottish army at the Battle of Methven.
dz: 彭布罗克伯爵的军队在梅斯文战役中击败了布鲁斯的苏格兰军队.
de: The Earl of Pembroke's army defeats Bruce's Scottish army at the Battle of Methven.
